positions.name: PallasineChecklistAsAuthoritativeProcess
positions.frame: what establishes the Pallasine checklist as the current, binding onboarding process rather than an optional resource?
positions.why: src-1 performs the checklist as a universal mandate ('Every new hire completes') and src-2 grounds that mandate historically by naming what it superseded ('replaced the old wiki page last quarter') — together the pair reads as establishing the checklist's authority through both present enactment and institutional succession, both delivered in the same flat, matter-of-fact register (per the register direction) with no persuasive framing, consistent with an already-settled procedural fact rather than an argued position.
